title: 1,4-Diol Hq (TBHQ) vs 1,4-dithiol (TBDT); simulation of safe antioxidant with a lower carcinogenic activity.
authors: Mosavi, Seyed Zahra; Colagar, Abasalt Hosseinzadeh; Zahedi, Tahereh; Seyedalipour, Bagher
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接比较TBHQ与TBDT与AhR、ERalpha及Keap1/Nrf2的亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子抗氧化剂而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: tert-Butylhydroquinone (TBHQ) is an antioxidant and preservative used in unsaturated vegetable oils and processed foods. However, when consumed in higher doses daily, it may pose a threat to public health by potentially increasing the risk of cancer, as it has an affinity with both the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) and the estrogen receptor alpha (ERalpha). METHODS: This study aimed to examine the impact of substituting the 1,4-diol of TBHQ with 1,4-dithiol, referred to as TBDT, on the carcinogenic and antioxidant systems using computational methods. The binding affinity of TBHQ and TBDT to the two carcinogenic receptors, AhR and ERalpha, as well as to the antioxidant receptor Keap1 alone and in connection with Nrf2 (Nrf2-Keap1) was investigated through docking analysis. RESULTS: The results indicated a decrease in TBDT's binding strength to ERalpha and AhR when assessed using Molegro Virtual Docker (P-value: 0.0001 and 0.00001, respectively), AutoDock Vina (P-value: 0.0001 and 0.0001), and the online server Fast DRH (P-value: 0.0001 and 0.0001). However, TBDT's binding affinity to Keap1 was predicted to be significantly stronger than TBHQ's by both MVD and AutoDock Vina (P-value: 0.0001 and 0.04), while its binding to Nrf2-Keap1 assessed to be stronger only by MVD (P-value: 0.0001). CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that TBDT not only exhibits higher antioxidant activity as a better ligand for the antioxidant system but also shows lower affinity with the AhR and ERalpha receptors. Therefore, TBDT can be considered a safer compound than TBHQ.
abstract_zh: 目的：叔丁基对苯二酚（TBHQ）是一种用于不饱和植物油和加工食品中的抗氧化剂和防腐剂。然而，当每日以较高剂量摄入时，它可能通过增加癌症风险对公众健康构成威胁，因为它与芳基烃受体（AhR）和雌激素受体α（ERalpha）均具有亲和性。方法：本研究旨在通过计算方法考察将TBHQ的1,4-二醇替换为1,4-二硫醇（称为TBDT）对致癌系统和抗氧化系统的影响。通过对接分析，研究了TBHQ和TBDT与两种致癌受体AhR和ERalpha，以及单独与抗氧化受体Keap1和与Nrf2结合（Nrf2-Keap1）时的结合亲和力。结果：结果表明，使用Molegro Virtual Docker（P值分别为0.0001和0.00001）、AutoDock Vina（P值分别为0.0001和0.0001）以及在线服务器Fast DRH（P值分别为0.0001和0.0001）评估时，TBDT与ERalpha和AhR的结合强度有所降低。然而，MVD和AutoDock Vina均预测TBDT与Keap1的结合亲和力显著强于TBHQ（P值分别为0.0001和0.04），而其与Nrf2-Keap1的结合仅由MVD评估为更强（P值：0.0001）。结论：这些发现表明，TBDT不仅作为抗氧化系统的更好配体表现出更高的抗氧化活性，而且与AhR和ERalpha受体的亲和力较低。因此，TBDT可被视为比TBHQ更安全的化合物。
